info.name: Sovra — API Key endpoints
info.description:
Server-to-server endpoints authenticated by a workspace API key.

All requests require:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}
```

The key must be a workspace API key issued from the dashboard or via `POST /dashboard/workspaces/{workspace_id}/api_keys` (prefix `sovra_sk_`). Set `baseUrl` and `apiKey` in the collection variables (or override per environment).

item.name: Issuer
item.description: Server-to-server issuer lifecycle ops scoped to the authenticated workspace.

request.description:
Create an issuer-initiated credential offer. Requires `schema_id`; `claims` are pre-bound to the offer and copied into the issued credential when the holder redeems it.

`valid_until` is optional: an absolute RFC 3339 instant overriding the schema's `validity_period` for this credential, for re-issuing one that must keep the original expiration. Remove the line to derive expiry from the schema — an explicit `null` is rejected, as is a date in the past.

Rate limit: 120 req/min per API key.
List all credentials issued by the authenticated workspace.

Return metadata for a credential. The same id covers the full lifecycle: while the holder hasn't claimed yet the response has `status: "pending"` (or `"expired"` if the offer window passed) with a null credential payload; after issuance, status reflects the revocation state confirmed on-chain, and `pending_status` names a requested change that has not landed yet.

Requests a status transition. Allowed values: `revoked`, `suspended`, `issued`. Answers 202 with the target in `pending_status`; the change is written to the on-chain status list in the background, and `status` moves once it lands, announced by the `credential.revoked` / `credential.suspended` / `credential.unsuspended` webhook. If it never lands, `credential.status-change-failed` is sent and `status` stays as it was. A second change while one is pending is a 409 `status_change_pending`. On the API-key pipeline the workspace's API key is sufficient.

item.name: Verifier
item.description: OID4VP verification sessions scoped to the authenticated workspace.

request.description: Start an OID4VP verification session. `dcql_query` follows the OID4VP DCQL spec — list the credentials and claims you want the wallet to disclose.
List sessions owned by the authenticated workspace, newest first.
Fetch the current state of a verification session owned by the authenticated workspace.
